definitions.is_equivalent_to: X and Y are the same thing, different names for it, or equal and interchangeable (includes numerical equality).
definitions.is_used_for: X is used for, applied to, or is a tool for analysing Y.
definitions.causes: X causes or leads to Y (includes 'results in').
definitions.is_represented_by: X can be expressed or written as Y (an expansion, form or representation).
definitions.consists_of: X is made of, or can be decomposed into, the parts Y.
definitions.has_property: X has, or exhibits, the attribute, characteristic or behaviour Y (causal, linear, stable, zero phase, ringing...).
definitions.implies: If X holds then Y follows (includes 'X is sufficient for Y').
definitions.corresponds_to: X is paired with, or is the discrete-time/continuous-time counterpart of, Y; related but not identical.
